title: Did you know… Gehazi lost everything because of hidden greed?
paragraphs: Did you know… Gehazi lost everything because of hidden greed?

You can hide it from people.
You cannot hide it from God.

Gehazi looked clean on the outside.
Servant of the prophet. Close to power. Near miracles.
But inside?
Greed was growing in silence.

In 2 Kings 5, a man named Naaman was healed—instantly—by God’s mercy through Elisha.
No payment required.
Grace was free.
But Gehazi couldn’t stand it.

Free felt… wasteful.
Grace felt… unprofitable.

So he ran after Naaman.
Lied.
Took silver.
Took garments.
Then hid it.
Hidden sin always feels safe… until God speaks.

Elisha looked at him and said, “Was not my spirit with you?”
Translation?
“I saw everything.”

And in one moment—
Position gone.
Honor gone.
Health gone.
Leprosy replaced the life he tried to upgrade.
But here’s what we miss…

Gehazi didn’t fall because of money.
He fell because he valued the gift more than the Giver.
And that disease still spreads today.

We hide compromise.
We justify small lies.
We chase what looks “deserved.”
But sin, when fully grown, always collects its payment.
And that’s where grace walks in.

Because where Gehazi failed—
Jesus stood.

Jesus Christ didn’t take what wasn’t His.
He gave what we didn’t deserve.

On the cross, He carried the deeper leprosy—
our sin.
So you don’t have to hide anymore.

You can come clean.
You can come home.
We tell the stories that shame tried to erase.
